quarterly_data.signal: Disco stated that, after inquiries with Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, it confirmed that no new export controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment covering its products had been promulgated or implemented, contrary to social-media claims of controls effective August 1, 2026, and that it will continue to supply products and services to its customers in compliance with all applicable laws.
